home.title: Welcome to Lordaeron
home.subtitle: The ultimate Epic Progressive WoW experience — from Vanilla to WotLK
home.epicProgressionDesc: Defeat the trials of each tier to unlock the next — with a full raid, or solo and in small groups via the Lone Champion's Path. Progress through every WoW tier from Vanilla through TBC to Wrath of the Lich King.

howTo.title: How to Connect
howTo.subtitle: Follow these simple steps to join {realm}
howTo.realmSoon: {realm} opens soon: get your client ready now, the realm will appear in the realm list on opening day.
howTo.realmReservation: Log in to {realm} now to create your characters and keep your names. The world opens on {date}.
howTo.step1Desc: Download World of Warcraft version 3.3.5a (build 12340). You can find it on popular WoW archive sites.
howTo.step2Desc: Open your WoW folder, navigate to Data/enUS/ (or your locale folder), and open realmlist.wtf. Replace its contents with:
howTo.step3Desc: Register on our website using the registration form. Your account will be ready instantly.
howTo.step4Desc: Delete the Cache folder located at the root of your WoW directory (next to Wow.exe). This ensures you stay up to date with the server's latest data. It's good practice to do this regularly or after each update.
howTo.step5Desc: Download the patch-Z.MPQ file and place it in your WoW Data/ folder (next to the other .MPQ files). This patch adjusts the client to match the server's custom settings (guild bank tab prices, etc.). If you already have a patch-Z.MPQ, rename one of them to patch-Y.MPQ or patch-X.MPQ to keep both.
howTo.stepPatchDesc: Download patch-W.MPQ and patch-Z.MPQ and put both in your WoW's Data/ folder (next to the other .MPQ files). patch-W brings all of {realm}'s content: the new race and class pairs, talents, spells, items and mounts; without it they are missing or show wrongly. patch-Z fits the client to the server's settings (guild bank tabs, dungeon finder).
howTo.stepPatchSoon: patch-W.MPQ will be available here before the name reservation opens.
howTo.stepPatchFolder: patch-W changes the talent trees and spells: left in your Lordaeron client, it would show talents that don't exist there. Copy your WoW folder (for example "WoW Rimeheart") and put patch-W in that copy only; patch-Z goes in both.
howTo.stepPatchUpdates: The patch evolves with the realm: download it again when a new version is announced on Discord, then delete the Cache folder.
howTo.step6Desc: Launch WoW.exe, log in with your credentials, pick {realm} in the realm list and enjoy!

features.fourProfessionsDesc: Learn up to 4 primary professions instead of the usual 2 — master more crafts on a single character

features.epicProgressionDesc: Defeat every final boss of each raid in release order — from Vanilla through TBC to WotLK. You must clear each tier before unlocking the next. Two roads lead there: the great raids, or the Lone Champion's Path.

features.raidScalingDesc: Raids and dungeons dynamically adapt to your group size. Fewer players means weaker creatures — loot always drops at full rate.
features.soloQueueDesc: No group needed — queue solo for any specific dungeon or random dungeon and get teleported inside instantly.
features.autolearnSpellsDesc: Automatically learn new spells as you level up
features.loneChampionDesc: No raid roster? Progress solo or with a few friends: heroic dungeon trials, farming commissions, and the Archivists — vendors selling raid-only recipes and materials for gold and emblems.

cgu.title: Terms of Use
cgu.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using Lordaeron.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content:
By accessing and using the Lordaeron website and game server, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our services.

These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and the Lordaeron team. We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time, and it is your responsibility to review them periodically.

access.title: 2. Access and Eligibility
access.content:
Lordaeron is a free-to-play World of Warcraft private server. You must be at least 13 years of age to create an account and use our services.

Access to the server is provided free of charge. Optional cosmetic and convenience items may be purchased through our in-game shop using Soul Shards, our virtual currency. No purchase is required to enjoy the full game experience.

account.title: 3. Account Responsibilities
account.content:
You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must not share, sell, trade, or transfer your account to any other person.

Each person may only create and maintain one account. Multi-accounting to gain unfair advantages is strictly prohibited and may result in the suspension or permanent ban of all associated accounts.

You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.

conduct.title: 4. Code of Conduct
conduct.content:
All players must adhere to the following rules:

- No cheating, hacking, or using unauthorized third-party software (bots, speed hacks, fly hacks, etc.)
- No exploiting bugs or game mechanics — report any exploits to the team
- No harassment, hate speech, discrimination, or toxic behavior towards other players
- No real-money trading (RMT) of in-game items, gold, or accounts outside of our official shop
- No impersonation of staff members or other players
- No spamming or advertising in any game channels

Violation of these rules may result in warnings, temporary mutes, temporary bans, or permanent bans at the discretion of the Lordaeron team.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual Property
ip.content:
World of Warcraft and all related content, names, and imagery are the property of Blizzard Entertainment. Lordaeron is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Blizzard Entertainment.

All original content created by the Lordaeron team (website design, custom features, configurations) remains the property of the Lordaeron project.

liability.title: 6. Limitations of Liability
liability.content:
Lordaeron is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.

The Lordaeron team is not liable for any loss of in-game progress, items, characters, or data resulting from server issues, maintenance, rollbacks, or any other circumstances.

We reserve the right to perform server maintenance, updates, or resets as necessary without prior notice.

termination.title: 7. Account Termination
termination.content:
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time, with or without cause, with or without notice. Reasons for termination may include, but are not limited to:

- Violation of these Terms of Use
- Violation of the Code of Conduct
- Cheating, exploiting, or using unauthorized software
- Fraudulent activity or chargebacks on Soul Shard purchases

You may request account deletion at any time by contacting us through the contact form.

modifications.title: 8. Modifications to Terms
modifications.content:
The Lordaeron team reserves the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Your continued use of Lordaeron after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

cgv.title: Terms of Sale
cgv.subtitle: Terms governing purchases made on Lordaeron.

general.title: 1. General Information
general.content:
These Terms of Sale govern all purchases made through the Lordaeron website shop. By making a purchase, you agree to these terms.

The seller is the site's publisher, Lordaeron, an independent fan project, identified in the legal notice. All transactions are processed in Euros (EUR) and are subject to applicable taxes and regulations.

soulShards.title: 2. Soul Shards — Virtual Currency
soulShards.content:
Soul Shards are Lordaeron's virtual currency used exclusively within our in-game shop. Soul Shards have no real-world monetary value and cannot be exchanged for real currency.

Soul Shards are non-transferable between accounts. They are linked to the account that purchased them and cannot be gifted, traded, or sold to other players.

The Lordaeron team reserves the right to modify Soul Shard packages, pricing, and availability at any time.

pricing.title: 3. Pricing and Packages
pricing.content:
All prices are displayed in Euros (EUR) and include applicable taxes. Available Soul Shard packages and their prices are displayed on the shop page.

Prices are subject to change without prior notice. The price at the time of purchase is the price that applies to your transaction.

payment.title: 4. Payment
payment.content:
All payments are processed securely through Stripe, a PCI DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We do not store your credit card information on our servers.

Accepted payment methods include credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), debit cards, and other methods supported by Stripe in your region.

Payments are processed immediately upon confirmation. Soul Shards are credited to your account as soon as the payment is confirmed by Stripe.

delivery.title: 5. Delivery
delivery.content:
Soul Shards are delivered digitally and instantly to your Lordaeron account upon successful payment confirmation.

In-game items purchased with Soul Shards are delivered directly to the selected character's mailbox or inventory within seconds of the purchase.

If you do not receive your Soul Shards or items within a reasonable time, please contact us through the contact form.

refund.title: 6. Refund Policy
refund.content:
Soul Shard purchases: In accordance with EU Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights, you acknowledge that digital content delivery begins immediately upon purchase. By completing a purchase, you expressly consent to this immediate delivery and waive your 14-day withdrawal right.

In-game item purchases: Items purchased with Soul Shards may be refunded within 2 hours of purchase, provided the item remains in the character's inventory and has not been used, equipped, or transferred. Soul Shards will be credited back to your account upon successful refund.

Chargebacks: Initiating a chargeback with your bank without first contacting us may result in the suspension of your account. Please contact us first if you have any issues with a transaction.

shopItems.title: 7. Shop Items and Services
shopItems.content:
The in-game shop offers cosmetic items, convenience items, and character services. These include mounts, transmog sets, bags, heirlooms, pets, toys, and services such as name changes, appearance changes, race changes, and faction changes.

All items and services are provided as described on the shop page. The Lordaeron team reserves the right to modify, remove, or rebalance any shop item or service at any time.

Purchased items and services are non-transferable between accounts unless explicitly stated otherwise (e.g., the gifting feature).

liabilityLimit.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liabilityLimit.content:
The Lordaeron team's total liability for any claim arising from a purchase shall not exceed the amount paid by you for that specific transaction.

We are not responsible for any losses resulting from server downtime, character loss, item loss, or other in-game events beyond our reasonable control.

For any disputes, please contact us through the contact form. We are committed to resolving issues fairly and promptly.

rgpd.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
rgpd.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.content:
The data controller for personal data processed through the Lordaeron website and game servers is the site's publisher, Lordaeron, an independent fan project, identified in the legal notice.

For any questions regarding your personal data or to exercise your rights, contact us on Lordaeron's official Discord or through an in-game ticket to the game masters.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following personal data:

- Account information: username, email address
- Connection data: IP address, login timestamps
- Game data: character names, levels, play time, in-game activity
- Purchase data: transaction history, Soul Shard balance, payment references (we do not store credit card details)
- Contact data: messages sent through the contact form

We do not collect sensitive personal data (racial origin, political opinions, health data, etc.).

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
purposes.content:
Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:

- Account creation and authentication
- Providing and maintaining the game service
- Processing shop purchases and managing Soul Shard balances
- Ensuring server security and preventing cheating
- Responding to support requests via the contact form
- Sending important service announcements (e.g., maintenance, updates)

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis
legalBasis.content:
We process your data under the following legal bases as defined by the GDPR:

- Contract performance (Article 6(1)(b)): Processing necessary to provide the game service and fulfill purchases
- Legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)): Server security, anti-cheat measures, and service improvement
- Consent (Article 6(1)(a)): For optional cookies and marketing communications (if any)

You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

storage.title: 5. Data Storage and Retention
storage.content:
Your data is stored on servers located within the European Union.

Retention periods:
- Account data: retained for the duration of your account's existence
- Game data: retained for the duration of your account's existence
- Purchase data: retained for 5 years for legal and accounting purposes
- Contact messages: retained for 1 year
- Connection logs (IP addresses): retained for 6 months

Upon account deletion request, your personal data will be deleted within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.

thirdParties.title: 6. Third Parties
thirdParties.content:
We share your data only with the following third parties:

- Stripe (payment processor): When you make a purchase, your payment information is processed directly by Stripe. Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 certified and acts as an independent data controller for payment data. See Stripe's privacy policy at stripe.com/privacy.

- Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France, European Union): sends our e-mails (account e-mails and, if you asked for them, news) on our behalf, as a processor. It receives your e-mail address and the content of the message only.

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with any other third parties for marketing or commercial purposes.

rights.title: 7. Your GDPR Rights
rights.content:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

- Right of access (Article 15): Request a copy of your personal data
- Right to rectification (Article 16): Request correction of inaccurate data
- Right to erasure (Article 17): Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
- Right to restrict processing (Article 18): Request limitation of data processing
- Right to data portability (Article 20): Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
- Right to object (Article 21): Object to data processing based on legitimate interests

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through the contact form. We will respond to your request within 30 days.

emails.title: 9. E-mails
emails.content:
Your e-mail address is required to create an account; it is confirmed by a link (valid 48 hours).

Account e-mails: the confirmation of your address, the password reset, and security notices (a change of address, two-step verification turned on or off). They are necessary to provide the service and keep your account safe (Article 6(1)(b) and (f)), and are sent whatever your news preferences.

Lordaeron's dispatches (news): realm openings, patches, events and shop offers. Only with your consent (Article 6(1)(a)): the box is unchecked at signup, and you can change your choice at any time from your account page or with the one-click unsubscribe link at the bottom of every news e-mail. They are sent only to a confirmed address.

Proof of consent: we keep the date, the version of the wording you accepted, where it was given (signup, account page, unsubscribe link) and the IP address, for as long as your account exists and 3 years after a withdrawal.

A change of address applies only once the link sent to the new address is opened; the old address is told. Confirmation links are stored as fingerprints (hashes), expire after 24 to 48 hours and work once.

We never sell or lend your address.

secondFactor.title: 10. Two-step verification
secondFactor.content:
Two-step verification is optional. If you turn it on, we store the secret of your authenticator app, used only to check your codes in game and on the website, and the time step of the last code used (so that a code cannot be used twice). Failed sign-in attempts (account and IP address) are kept 15 minutes to lock out guessing.

The secret is deleted as soon as you turn the protection off. The record of the Core Hound Pup reward is kept for as long as your account exists, so that it is given once.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.content:
Lordaeron only sets the cookies the site's operation requires, which are exempt from consent:

- lordaeron_session: keeps you signed in after logging in (HttpOnly, Secure, 7 days).

- NEXT_LOCALE: remembers the chosen language (until the browser is closed).

- lordaeron_admin_session and lordaeron_admin_preview: for the site's administrators only (8 hours).

A few preferences (information banner closed, shop filters, vote panel folded) are kept in your browser's local storage and stay on your device.

We use no analytics, tracking or advertising cookie, and no third-party cookie.

legalNotice.authoritative: Lordaeron's legal texts (legal notice, terms of use, terms of sale, privacy policy) are translated into several languages: in case of discrepancy, the English version prevails.

providers.p1: Some pages show game icons loaded from wow.zamimg.com (Wowhead's image server): your browser then sends your IP address to this server, which sets no cookie.

service.title: 4. The service
service.p1: Lordaeron is an unofficial private server of the game World of Warcraft (version 3.3.5a). Creating an account and playing are free.
service.p2: The site offers the optional purchase of Soul Shards, a virtual currency exchanged for in-game items and services, under the <cgv>Terms of Sale</cgv>. Use of the site and the game is governed by the <cgu>Terms of Use</cgu> and restricted to people aged 13 and over.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual property and trademarks
ip.p1: World of Warcraft, Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. in the U.S. and other countries. The universe, names, characters, images, icons and content of the game World of Warcraft belong to Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.
ip.p2: Lordaeron is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment, nor endorsed, sponsored or supported by Blizzard Entertainment. The images from Blizzard Entertainment's press kits and the game icons shown on the site remain the property of their owners.
ip.p3: The texts, layout, code and original creations of the site and the server (Lordaeron's own content and settings) belong to the publisher. Reproducing them without permission is prohibited.
ip.p4: Any rights holder who believes that content on the site infringes their rights can request its removal through the contact means given in section 1, stating the content concerned, where it appears on the site and the rights invoked. Requests are handled without delay.

data.title: 6. Personal data
data.p1: The publisher processes personal data to run the accounts, the game, the shop and the e-mails, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act. The processing, its purposes, recipients and retention periods are detailed in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
data.p2: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data, which you exercise through the contact means given in section 1. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (<cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>).

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and local storage
cookies.lead: The site only sets the cookies its operation requires, which are exempt from consent:

session.purpose: Keep you signed in after logging in

adminPreview.purpose: Administrators' preview of realms not open yet (administrators only)

cookies.p1: The site also keeps a few preferences in your browser's local storage (information banner closed, shop filters, vote panel folded): they stay on your device.
cookies.p2: The site uses no advertising, audience measurement or tracking cookie, and no third-party cookie. Payment takes place on Stripe's secure page, under its own policy.

report.title: 8. Reporting illegal content
report.p1: In accordance with the French Law for Confidence in the Digital Economy (LCEN) and the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), any manifestly illegal content on the site or in the game (character or guild name, message, image) can be reported to the publisher: in game through a ticket to the game masters, or on the <discord>official Discord</discord>.
report.p2: State the date, the content concerned and where it is (page address, realm, character name), and why you consider it illegal. The publisher reviews every report and promptly removes any illegal content.

liability.title: 9. Liability, links and availability

branding.desc1: Lordaeron is a free-to-play Epic Progressive WoW server running on patch 3.3.5a. Players progress through every raid tier in release order — from Vanilla through The Burning Crusade to Wrath of the Lich King — by defeating the final boss(es) of each tier to unlock the next.
branding.desc2: The server features enhanced rates (x5 XP, x2 Honor, x2 Professions, x2 Reputation) for a faster but balanced leveling experience. Raids reset every Wednesday and Sunday at 5 AM with full loot every time, and dungeons have no lockout so you can run them as many times as you want.
branding.desc3: Quality-of-life features include Transmogrification, Crossfaction grouping (Alliance and Horde play together), AOE Loot, Autolearn Spells, and a unique Tank as DPS system — queue as Tank in dungeons while staying in your DPS spec for faster group finding, with an automatic bonus to health and threat.
branding.desc4: An optional cosmetic shop powered by Soul Shards offers mounts, transmog sets, heirlooms, bags, pets, toys, and character services. No purchase is required to enjoy the full game experience.

epicProgression.title: Epic Progression
epicProgression.subtitle: Progress through every WoW tier — by raid, or by the Lone Champion's Path
epicProgression.introDesc: Epic Progression is Lordaeron's core gameplay system. Each character must defeat the final boss(es) of a raid tier to unlock the next one. Progression is per-character — not per-account or per-server. Each hero writes their own story, from the depths of Molten Core to the icy throne of the Lich King. The whole server runs on a WotLK 3.3.5a setup — spells, talents, quests — but content is unlocked progressively. Two roads lead through each expansion: the great raids, or the Lone Champion's Path for solo players and small groups.
epicProgression.dkDesc: Death Knights are available as usual from level 55, but they are also subject to Epic Progression. Their starting gear stats have been rebalanced so they are not overpowered during the Vanilla expansion.
epicProgression.stayOnTierDesc: You are never forced to move on. You can choose not to turn in the final quest and stay on your current expansion as long as you want. This lets you create guilds, gather friends, and progress together at your own pace before moving to the next expansion.
epicProgression.vanillaDesc: Begin your journey in classic Azeroth. Conquer Molten Core, Blackwing Lair, Zul'Gurub, and the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Defeat the final bosses of each raid to advance through the tiers.
epicProgression.tbcDesc: Step through the Dark Portal into Outland. From Karazhan to the Sunwell Plateau, face the most iconic bosses of the Burning Legion and Illidan's forces.
epicProgression.wotlkDesc: March to Northrend and face the greatest threat Azeroth has ever known. From the halls of Naxxramas to the pinnacle of Icecrown Citadel, your path leads to the Lich King himself.
epicProgression.restrictionsDesc: To ensure fair progression and prevent boosting, players from different expansions cannot interact in certain ways:
epicProgression.restrictionGroup: No grouping with players from a different expansion
epicProgression.restrictionTrade: No trading with players from a different expansion
epicProgression.restrictionAH: No Auction House transactions between expansions
epicProgression.restrictionGuildBank: No Guild Bank access across expansions
epicProgression.restrictionMail: No mail between players from different expansions
epicProgression.restrictionsWhy: These restrictions exist to preserve the integrity of progression. They prevent boosting, ensure every player earns their progress, and maintain the challenge of each expansion.
epicProgression.restrictionsWithinExpansion: Within the same expansion, all players can freely play together regardless of their current raid tier.
epicProgression.questDesc: To advance from one expansion to the next, you must complete a quest given by your faction's leader. After defeating the final boss of an expansion, return to the quest NPC to validate your kill and unlock the next expansion. In Vanilla, speak to Varian Wrynn (Alliance) or Thrall (Horde). In TBC, find A'dal in Shattrath. In WotLK, head to Rhonin in Dalaran. On the Lone Champion's Path, the same unlocks come from quest chains through heroic dungeons and world farming, guided by the Archivists.
epicProgression.pathsDesc: Every expansion can be conquered in two ways. Pick your road — and switch at every expansion boundary.
epicProgression.raidPathDesc: The classic road: gather your guild and defeat the final bosses of each raid tier, from Molten Core to the Ruby Sanctum, in full 10/25/40-player battles.
epicProgression.lcpPathDesc: No raid roster? Walk the champion's road: solo or with a trusted few, clear heroic dungeon trials, fill farming commissions across the world and earn the emblems of each era. Same expansion unlocks, at your own pace.
epicProgression.archivistsDesc: A new order of vendors stands in Stormwind, Orgrimmar, Shattrath and Dalaran: the Archivists sell raid-only profession recipes and crafting materials for gold and emblems, hand out farming commissions, and pay standing rates for the components you bring back. Both roads begin with them — every champion is sent to meet their era's Archivist.
epicProgression.pathSwitchNote: You can switch between the raid path and the Lone Champion's Path at every expansion boundary.

raidScaling.title: Difficulty Scaling
raidScaling.subtitle: Raids and dungeons dynamically adapt to your group size — play with any number of players
raidScaling.introDesc: When your group enters an instance with fewer players than the maximum capacity, all creatures are automatically scaled down. Health and damage adjust in real time whenever someone joins, leaves, or disconnects. Loot always drops at full rate regardless of group size. At full capacity, everything stays at 100% — no scaling applied.
